publish_rules.first_parent: Actual approved current main at future publication, then preceding archive commit
publish_rules.additional_parents: Exactly each batch frozen head list; no protected or active head
publish_rules.tree: Copy the actual first-parent tree and add only new archive docs; all existing blobs and modes remain byte-identical
publish_rules.moving_main: Pause, refresh actual main, rebuild/review the docs-only archival proposal without overwriting production, then update the draft PR through its owner; never directly update main.
publish_rules.moving_old_ref: Retain ref; the archived frozen head does not preserve newer commits at a moved ref
publish_rules.delete_gate: Only after final archive tip is reachable from main and each frozen head is confirmed an ancestor; root rechecks current ref/open PR/writer before any deletion
publish_rules.active_integration_order: PR159 and PR161 are actually merged in b4f296e; other active wave3/new templates work remains protected. Archive parents must wait for active integration/owner coordination.
publish_rules.publication_route: Only a draft PR targeting main; root independent review; then normal merge commit with merge_method=merge and expected_head_sha=reviewed_PR_head. Direct main ref update is forbidden.
